## 3. Gradient scale (frame deviation from scale 1 after 300 steps)

Gated rows start from gauge-free frames (square stream with the default initialization; identity initialization on 32×48). `rect_default` is the pre-registered implementation: the first gradient's GᵀG is rank-deficient, so eigh's basis of its null space is arbitrary and rounding differences select different bases (F-015); the flow then re-converges, as the distance modulo signed permutations shows.
